summary: Implemented and built first HiDPI viewport-mapping candidate. Existing opt-in physical swapchain backbuffer now expands only full-size logical D3D11 viewports and associated scissors by 2 when bound render-target dimensions are exactly 2x; API-visible state and Wine CAMetalLayer geometry remain unchanged. ARM64EC d3d11.dll SHA-1 a934e78bc859194023ead00cf8a909a2e63f3020. Deployed only in Elite-arm-test with timestamped config/registry/DLL backups, native d3d11 override, and d3d11.hidpiNativeResolution=True for validation.
